rewards: Ability to craft and wield Elemental equipment.

st.t: Go into the house just south-west of the Seers' Village bank and search the bookcase on its east wall.
Use a knife on the battered book.
Go to the anvil building just north-west of this house and open the odd-looking wall on its north side.
In the north room, turn the water control east of the water wheel. This one must be turned first.
Turn the water control west of the water wheel. If you turned this one first, turn it back and start again with the east control.
Pull the lever in the north room.
Repair the bellows in the east room.
Pull the lever next to the bellows.
Search the boxes in the north east of the central room.
Use the stone bowl on the lava trough in the south room.
Use the lava-filled bowl on the furnace.
Mine one of the elemental rocks in the west room, ready to fight a level 35.
Kill the rock elemental that appeared.
Use the elemental ore on the furnace in the south room.
Use the bar on one of the workbenches in the central room to complete the quest.
